pieces.doc: Arrow pointing from the card back to its trigger. Floating-ui places it along the right edge so the consumer only has to give it a size and a background — no positioning math required.

The hover-card surface. Portaled to `document.body` and positioned by floating-ui (via the shared `injectOverlayShell` helper). Pointer-enter on the content cancels the pending close, so the user can move the cursor from the trigger into the card to interact with its content (links, buttons, copy targets).
Element that activates the hover-card on hover or focus. Apply on a link, a button, or any focusable element that already conveys the underlying action (the card adds preview, not meaning).
Headless hover-preview card. Use it to surface rich, interactive previews (profile snapshots, link previews, definition cards) on hover or focus of an already-meaningful trigger (a link, a name).

inputs.name: _openInput
inputs.doc: Backing input for `[(open)]` two-way binding. Internal — read the user-facing `open` writable signal instead, which derives its value from this input plus `disabled` via `linkedSignal`.

inputs.name: side
inputs.doc: Side the card is anchored to. Defaults to `'top'`. Pair with `align` for the full positioning API.

inputs.name: align
inputs.doc: Alignment along the chosen `side`. Defaults to `'center'`.

inputs.name: sideOffset
inputs.doc: Gap (px) between trigger and card along the main axis. Default `8`. Mirrors Radix's `sideOffset`.

inputs.name: alignOffset
inputs.doc: Gap (px) along the cross axis. Default `0`.

inputs.name: avoidCollisions
inputs.doc: When `true` (default), `flip` and `shift` keep the card inside the viewport.

inputs.name: collisionPadding
inputs.doc: Padding (px) applied uniformly to flip / shift / size. Default `8`.

inputs.name: hideWhenDetached
inputs.doc: When `true`, sets `data-detached=""` while the trigger is scrolled off-screen.

inputs.name: openDelay
inputs.doc: Per-card override for open delay (ms). Falls back to coordinator (700ms).

inputs.name: closeDelay
inputs.doc: Per-card override for close delay (ms). Falls back to coordinator (300ms).

inputs.name: disabled
inputs.doc: When true, all hover / focus interaction is ignored and any open card is forced closed.

outputs.name: openChange
outputs.doc: Emits when the directive itself transitions `open`. See `open` JSDoc.

outputs.name: escapeKeyDown
outputs.doc: Fires when the user presses Escape while the card is open, regardless of whether focus is on the trigger or inside the portaled content. Call `preventDefault()` on the emitted veto to suppress the automatic close. The native `KeyboardEvent` is on `.event`.

methods.name: emitEscapeKeyDown
methods.doc: Emit `(escapeKeyDown)` and, unless the consumer calls `preventDefault()` on the veto, close immediately. Called by the trigger and the portaled content so Escape works no matter where focus currently lives.
